The '''Feather Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that was the site of a [[Battle of the Feather Nebula|battle]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Western Reaches Operation|retaking]] of the region in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]]. It would later be documented in the [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] ''[[The Charge at Feather Nebula]]''.

==Behind the scenes==
The name of the nebula and the battle that takes place there is a reference to the Western film [[Wikipedia:The Charge at Feather River|''The Charge at Feather River'']], which was the first instance of the [[Wilhelm scream]].
